Yes—that gives me a clear direction.

What I understood is: you want one dependable place where pasting a web address creates a useful bookmark automatically, while still letting you correct or add details. Later, you should be able to find anything quickly through a readable list, tags, or a case-insensitive search across all its details. Saving the same address again should return you to the existing bookmark instead of creating a duplicate.

Is that the right overall goal?
